messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — pushed a runtime config (scope: routing.policies) to 10% cohort and noticed a lot of requests falling back to the default pool. Not sure if it's the new quota gating or our router logic. :eyes:
Maya: I see the same in the quota logs, burst rejects spiked ~2x around the rollout time. digging into a few traces now.
Kevin: Can you paste the config payload and the commit id? want to check schema changes.
Jordan: commit f2e9b3a — payload snippet:
```json
{
  "id": "routing.v2",
  "cohort": 0.1,
  "policies": [{ "match": {"region": "us"}, "quota": {"per_min": 1200}, "fallback": "default-pool" }],
  "telemetry_gate": {"enabled": true, "error_threshold_pct": 1.5}
}
```
Maya: telemetry_gate was new in this rollout — looks like the gate tripped because transient 500s in one shard exceeded 1.5% briefly, so router started falling back.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: applied config routing.v2 @10% cohort by Jordan (f2e9b3a) — rollout started 2026-03-20T10:15:00Z.
Rachel: Console UX note: there's no visible "abort rollout" button on the config page right now. We only have the generic rollback path which is slow for partial cohorts. ops needs a quick pause.
Alex: Agree. Proposal: add an "emergency_pause" flag to runtime config that signals router to stop cohort expansion and force immediate 100% revert for affected nodes. Pseudocode:
```yaml
emergency_pause: true
affected_cohorts: [0.1]
reason: "telemetry_gate trip"
```
Kevin: That feels heavy — better to add a soft pause that flips cohort->0 and leaves config object intact (no full revert) so audit trail remains. Also need the console button to call `redwoodctl config modify --set cohort=0 --dry-run=false` and push a high-priority job.
Maya: +1 for soft pause. Also we should tweak telemetry_gate to have a cooldown window (e.g., require error > threshold for 3 consecutive minutes) to avoid transient flaps.
Jordan: Ops impact: if we flip cohort->0 quickly, can we ensure state converges before autoscaling decisions kick in? Need a short TTL on cache invalidation.
Alex: Router already honors config version stamps; we should add a 5s quiesce window after cohort change before autoscale signals. Low risk.
Rachel: I'll file a console PR to add Abort/Pause and surface the telemetry_gate reason in the UI. UX will show the diff, one-click pause, and an audit modal.
Kevin: I'll own schema change: implement soft-pause semantics and add cooldown param to telemetry_gate. Will run compatibility tests against old router clients.
Maya: Meanwhile, ops playbook update suggestion: if fallback rate > 10% and error_pct >1% for 3m => pause cohort, notify on-call, and roll a hotfix if necessary. I'll add metrics dashboards for that.
Jordan: Sounds good. I'll open the PRs and tag you all. For immediate mitigation, Maya can escalate to on-call to manually set cohort=0 for the 10% rollouts. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident-tracker: created issue #RLW-4822 "routing config fallback during rollout" assigned to Maya.
Maya: Doing the manual cohort=0 now and monitoring. Will report back in 5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
